Improve continuously: Work closely with Finance teams to find what they're working around and where the platform limits rather than enables them. You understand how the system works beneath the surface, not just how to use it. Integration experience: Operational experience with an iPaaS platform (Workato, Celigo, Boomi, Azure Integration Services or equivalent). You can investigate a failing integration and read execution logs. Finance understanding: Familiarity with AR, AP, bank reconciliation and period close. You know what the numbers mean and why Finance teams care about them. Your track record: Experience owning live systems and delivering measurable improvements, not just closing tickets. Global collaboration: English is our bridge language, allowing you to collaborate with Epassians from all our locations. Core competencies Analytical mindset: You trace problems to the root cause and understand why something works poorly before deciding how to improve it. Ownership: You drive conversations rather than respond to them, and bring improvements forward without waiting to be asked. Documentation discipline: You leave every runbook and process better than you found it, so someone else can pick it up without asking you. Why you should join us Own the technical outcome. This is not a maintenance role, and the platforms should work measurably better because of your work. Work in a live, complex, multi-market environment from day one, with more markets going live through the rest of 2026 and into 2027. Follow a clear growth path from NetSuite and integrations into CRM, AI and internal tech projects, with scope expanding as the function builds out around you. Help make AI and automation at Epassi possible by ensuring the platform and data foundations can be trusted. Be part of an ambitious growth journey and join a global community of driven, bold, entrepreneurial, yet humble Epassians. Thrive in an open and inclusive culture with low hierarchy, built on respect and shared successes. Come as you are. We'll bring out the best in you and support your personal and professional growth. Ready to make an impact, please send your CV and Talent Acquisition will be in touch!

review_candidates.title: Database Engineer with Security Clearance
review_candidates.description: About the Organization Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets. About the Role Redhorse is transforming how the government utilizes data and technology. We are looking for an experienced Database Engineer to join the team designing, building, and maintaining a new AWS-hosted, web-based internal tool used by non-technical end users to submit, review, approve, and track sensitive, highly regulated data requests on classified systems. The tool replaces a legacy web application and manual email- and spreadsheet-driven review with automated workflows, structured data capture, and AI-assisted review. As the Database Engineer, you will own the data layer of the application: modeling the request, review, and audit data; designing the relational and NoSQL stores that back the application; migrating data out of the legacy system; and making sure the database is secure, performant, auditable, and compliant with data-handling policies. You will work closely with application developers, cloud engineers, systems engineers, and policy experts across a multi-company team, and with stakeholders, to translate data-access policy into enforceable database design. This role works under general direction and is expected to independently determine the approach to difficult data problems. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain the application's database management systems in the AWS environment, including logical and physical data modeling, relational database architecture, and metadata/repository design. Model the request lifecycle (submission, revision, review, approval, fulfillment, dissemination) so that workflow state, justifications, and reviewer decisions are captured as structured, queryable data rather than free text, email, or spreadsheets. Implement database-level security controls for sensitive request data, including role- and attribute-based access control, row/column-level security, encryption at rest and in transit, and least-privilege service accounts. Design and implement data retention periods, purge workflows, and immutable audit trails that satisfy policy and compliance requirements. Analyze the legacy application's data and processes; perform source analysis, data mapping, and data transformation to plan and execute migration into the target environment. Determine data storage requirements and evaluate, size, and select database technology components (e.g., Amazon RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3) for the application. Write, review, and tune SQL queries, stored procedures, and indexes for performance and scalability; support developers with efficient data access patterns and APIs. Implement comprehensive backup, recovery, and replication solutions; define and test RPO/RTO targets. Establish database configuration management and schema change control (migration scripts, versioning) integrated into the team's CI/CD pipeline. Structure and prepare data to support rules-based validation and AI-assisted detection of common request errors, and to support reporting and metrics for customer leadership. Monitor database health, capacity, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve production data issues. Prepare system requirements, data dictionaries, and design documentation throughout implementation. Required Qualifications Active TS/SCI with Polygraph. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant experience; or a Master's degree and 3+ years of relevant experience.
